== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|An Unsouled is a person considered to be a cripple due to a perceived deformity or weakness in their soul. This condition prevents them from practicing [[sacred arts]], which in turn restricts their ability to engage in combat or travel. Because they cannot rise in status through traditional means, they are often viewed as having no honor to lose and may be treated with disdain or seen as a burden by their clans. In some cultures, such as [[Sacred Valley]], being Unsouled can lead to social isolation and a lack of protection. While they are generally unable to use most spiritual techniques, they may still possess the ability to utilize basic [[madra]] or power specific [[scripts]]. Some individuals may also choose to destroy their own cores as a defensive measure, resulting in an Unsouled state.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The term Unsouled describes an individual who lacks any affinity to their [[spirit]] and possesses no [[madra]]. Within the hierarchy of power, being Unsouled represents a specific rank or type of practitioner at the [[Foundation]] stage. Due to their perceived deformity, these individuals are forbidden from practicing [[sacred arts]] or marrying to prevent passing their condition to offspring. Despite these limitations, an Unsouled can still rise in power by utilizing the resources of a prestigious school of [[sacred arts]]. This designation is used by Wei Mon Keth{{!}}Keth to address [[Lindon]], characterizing him as someone who began his journey two steps behind others.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“There is no affinity to his spirit,” the First Elder says at last, and those close enough to hear gasp. “He is empty. Unsouled.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Stand where you are, Unsouled!” Keth roared, and the shout was driven with all the force of his madra and fury.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Unsouled?” She shrugged. “Never heard that word before coming here. You just started two steps behind, that’s the spine of it.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|“How did you make your way back here, Unsouled?”<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14" />}}
